text.p: Cardiometrics Inc said Monday it had submitted premarket notification to the Food and Drug Administration for its WaveWire/WaveMap intravascular blood pressure measurement system.

The company said WaveWire is a clinical angioplasty guide wire with pressure-sensing capability. It features a 0.014-inch angioplasty guide wire with an electronic pressure sensor mounted three centimeters from the tip.
The system allows analysis of not only mean pressures but also diastolic, systolic and other important hemodynamic parameters, the company said.
Measurements are processed and displayed by the WaveMap pressure instrument, which has a compact design that easily integrates into the catheterization laboratory, Cardiometrics said.
